evidence: Modifies src/node/mempool_args.cpp and test/functional/mempool_cluster.py to validate cluster limits and reject invalid negations.
rationale: Prevents an assertion crash in TxGraph caused by -nolimitclustercount when mempool sanity checks are enabled, and prevents transactions from failing with misleading errors on -limitclustersize=0. These startup validation fixes address edge-case configuration bugs without altering core transaction relay or eviction policies.
